# Danil Zanozin

> ML / AI Engineer focused on applied LLM agent safety, production AI systems, and quantitative research. This is his personal site and portfolio at danilzanozin.dev.

Danil Zanozin is an ML / AI Engineer. He sole-built Traciora, a production AI customer-operations platform, and sole-authored a manuscript on PII virtualization for LLM tool-calling agents (under review). He also builds systematic quantitative-trading systems. Education: B.S. Computer Science, Minors in Cybersecurity and Mathematics (California State University Channel Islands); incoming M.S. (Fall 2026).

## Work
- [Traciora](https://traciora.com): AI customer-operations platform — analyzes customer phone calls, handles routine ops, and answers from a complete picture of the business. Founder & sole engineer.
- [Kadabra](https://danilmezor.github.io/capstone-2026/): end-to-end systematic crypto trading framework with live execution and a multi-test robustness gate (live strategies).
- [TradingView Indicators](https://www.tradingview.com/u/mezor13/): curated Pine Script trading indicators and market features used daily by 1000+ traders.

## Research
- PII Virtualization: Reconciling Data Privacy and Tool-Calling Utility in LLM Agents — sole author, under review. A reversible session-scoped tokenization layer that cuts raw PII sent to external model providers to near-zero with no loss of tool-calling utility.
- Agentic AI for Autonomous Cyber Defense — co-author, in preparation. Constrained-POMDP formalization with a NIST CSF-aligned staged-autonomy taxonomy.
